title: Halloween Cop Faces Off with The Real Police
description:
A woman dressed in a police costume was arrested in Boardman, Ohio, after allegedly assaulting an officer. Police took Kaylee Dunas, 22, into custody after a simple traffic stop took a dramatic turn. Dunas and her boyfriend were pulled over for a traffic incident the weekend before Halloween, before she revealed her boyfriend had a warrant for his arrest. Officers acted on the warrant and arrested the boyfriend, seemingly planning to let Dunas off the hook, but she had other plans. The 22-year-old can be seen on body camera video berating police while dressed as one, even going so far as to allegedly kick one officer.
